messages.text: *Hark, mortal!* By the 14th hour of the clock, have the Zammad Docker spellbook summoned into existence, lest the server demons awaken!

*By the beard of Ada Lovelace, heed my scroll:* Hark, traveler! Cast the Zammad Docker spells into the sacred documentation tome before the clock strikes the twelfth hour, lest the ancient compilation demons awaken!
*Hark, mortal!* By the tenth bell of the clockwork, thy Zammad Docker grimoire must be forged, lest the ancient scripts consume thee!

*By the beard of Ada Lovelace, hear my arcane summons:* Hark, mortal! Thou shalt have the sacred Zammad Docker scrolls inscribed and delivered by the eighth hour, lest the ancient compilation demons consume thy soul!

out_of_office_message: Out of office: I am resting. Messages will appear during working hours.
